findings.title: API stayed available (100%) but p95 latency rose 41.2 -> 788.5 ms
findings.evidence: 112 requests, status counts {'200': 84, '204': 28}, p95 788.5 ms (baseline 41.2 ms)

summary: Adding latency to `gateway` (network_delay) moved API success from 100% to 100% across 112 samples; 1 service affected; recovered in 6 s without intervention.
production_implication: In production a network_delay on gateway would be absorbed with little or no user-visible impact.
